text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I went to the library to borrow some reference materials...

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Good grief, all you girls do is scroll through UmaTok... Why don't you follow Efforia-san's example and read some training books instead?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Ehh~ Even if you say that... Can reading books really help us win races~?

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, it can! So for starters—
everyone, let's read through every single book in the library♪

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh~ That's way too impossible!
—Ahaha. We'll start trying tomorrow~
choice_data_list: (Reading every single one is a bit much, though...)

Morniiing! —Wait, huh?
Eff-san is reading a fashion magazine!

text_block_list.text: Whoa~! Even Eff-san reads stuff like that! What kind of clothes do you like?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, basically speaking, I prefer traditional styles such as this.

Whoa. Is that... shonen manga?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I returned to the library to return the materials, Efforia was there just like a few days ago. However...

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: —W-What is that book!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: I mean... um, Eff-san? You've been reading nothing but unusual books lately... What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Are you researching something? If you'd like, we could help out...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your concern. However, that will not be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —I am merely following teacher's guidance and reading through the library's books from one end to the other.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: If it is to demonstrate excellence in the racing world, I shall do whatever it takes.
